newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-U.S. SELECTS HARD COURT FOR DAVIS CUP QUARTERS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-U.S. SELECTS HARD COURT FOR DAVIS CUP QUARTERS.

text.p: The United States will host the Netherlands on a California hard court in their Davis Cup quarter-final tie in April, the U.S. Tennis Association announced Wednesday.
The USTA selected the hard courts of the Palisades Tennis Club in Newport Beach, California for the April 4-6 Davis Cup meeting.

The Americans advanced to the quarter-finals Sunday by completing a 4-1 first-round victory over Brazil in Ribeiro Preto, Brazil, despite the absense of top U.S. players Pete Sampras, Michael Chang, Andre Agassi and Todd Martin.
The Netherlands, playing without injured Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek, rallied from an 0-2 deficit to defeat Romania 3-2 in Bucharest.
U.S. Davis Cup captain Tom Gullikson has until 10 days prior to the tie to name his four-man team.
